verdict.rationale: The evidence contains only a marketing assertion of "human-level accuracy" and feature-level mentions that transcripts are diarized and timestamped. That is the kind of unsubstantiated "AI-powered" claim the story contrasts against, not documentation of how transcription works. Nothing in the pack names the underlying ASR models, gives measured accuracy figures or a methodology, or lists known limits such as languages, accents, audio conditions or failure modes.

support.subject: As a product manager, the vendor documents how transcription actually works and its quality (models, accuracy claims, known limits) rather than just saying "AI-powered"
